All five experiments use the installed **rSPDE BRASIL coefficients** and
consistent FEM matrix solvers. Knit displays saved results without running
an experiment. The current numerical parameters are recorded in each notebook.

[Theory and all implementation functions](brasilfunc.html)

## Smooth data

- [Convergence in space](cov_in_h_mat.html): order eight, smooth finite-mode data.
- [Convergence in time](conv_in_tau_mat.html): order eight, fixed spatial mesh.
- [Isolated convergence in rational order](conv_in_m_isolated.html): orders 1–14,
  compared with exact-discrete backward Euler on the same FEM matrices.

## Rough data

- [Convergence in space](conv_in_h_rough.html): fixed infinite L2 forcing exposes
  the spatial alpha rate, with a logarithmic correction; rational order 14.
- [Convergence in time](conv_in_tau_rough.html): the same rough forcing,
  rational order 20 at alpha=0.5 and order 14 otherwise.
